assets.credit: NASA Visualization Technology Applications and Development (VTAD)
assets.role: NASA VTAD representative 3D model base-color texture; not an observed full-coverage map
assets.extraction: Exact embedded image bufferView bytes; no decoding, recoloring, resizing, filling or image generation
limitations: Representative visualization texture, not an independent observation or a measured cloud map at the selected model time.
The original OPAL observation maps remain separate and unchanged.
Texture-to-globe longitude/phase alignment is not validated.
